title: How to Brand Yourself Like a Celebrity
description:
Welcome to my brand new 12 part series: The Era’s Tour - Kayleigh’s Version!!
In this video, I’m walking you through how to brand yourself like a celebrity so you can finally stand out online, attract your audience, and step into your next era. ✨

Because let’s be real for a sec… Being forgettable online is worse than being disliked. Celebrities know this and that’s why they are masters at the branding playbook. We're gonna learn the very thing that makes people dress up to go to concerts, make friendship bracelets and model the aesthetics of the likes of Taylor Swift, Olivia Rodrigo and Charli XCX. 

We’ll breakdown:
* Why being forgettable is kinda fatal for your brand
* How celebrities like Sabrina Carpenter, Charli XCX, and Taylor Swift engineer their branding 
* How to create your own Main Character Mood Board (and character design your next era)
* Building your world: topics, metaphors, audience, and signature elements
* Auditing your profile + messaging (your digital PR team)
* Creating your signature content style and visuals

By the end, you’ll have the tools to start turning your brand into something unforgettable. This is part of my Era's Tour: Kayleigh's version - a 12 part series inspired by each of Taylor Swift's iconic albums. We'll be taking that album and breaking it down into a business, branding or content style training. Hope you're ready for your showgirl era
